notes: Strong 4-point opening, then spent many turns clicking for credits at 11-18 credits and never contested Server 1 or the naked remotes while the Corp scored out from the same server.

Fast scoring early and a sensible Phoneutria-protected remote late, but Hybrid Release dropped Flower Sermon into a naked remote and advanced it without scoring, giving away a free steal; some idle credit clicks and ice on an empty server mid-game.
From turn 5 onward the Runner clicked for credits nearly every click up to 79 credits, never installing a breaker or contesting remotes while the Corp scored five agendas.
Used Ansel 1.0 on HQ well to lock agendas and score out of an iced remote despite a thin economy; leaving the ADT-revealed Project Ingatan in a naked remote for two turns was risky.
Aggressive HQ/R&D pressure with run events won quickly; minor sloppiness leaving a tag that let Debbie be trashed and a low-credit Debbie facecheck into Ping.

Economy hovered near zero all game so remote ice could not be rezzed, ADT was stolen from an unrezzed server, and Drafter's install overwrote the advanced Méliès, trashing it into an open Archives where it was stolen for the win.
Gauss into HQ produced early steals and steady R&D pressure won; ran very credit-starved and left a tag that enabled Backroom Machinations after a low-credit R&D facecheck.
After a turn-1 steal the Runner clicked for credits for about 18 turns up to 88 credits, never installing anything or contesting the remote the Corp scored from repeatedly.

Mitosis put Longevity Serum in a naked remote where it was immediately stolen, and against a sabotage Runner the Corp let agendas go to an unprotected Archives and iced other servers instead, losing to a single Archives run.
Mavirus in the R&D root punished repeated runs, agendas were scored from iced remotes, and Bathynomus finished a flatline; moving Mavirus to Archives with Lotus Haze was an odd minor choice.
Sensible install-and-score pattern from iced remotes on a modest economy; Next Big Thing was advanced slowly and an empty remote was iced, but nothing costly.
Good setup with Gachapon into Banner and Buzzsaw, consistent HQ then R&D pressure and a correct Leech trash to steal SDS for the win; Leech counters were never otherwise used.

Spent clicks and credits piling up to five tags with Public Trail and Oppo Research but never punished them, while holding Next Big Thing and Tomorrow's Headline in a one-ice HQ instead of the three-ice remote, and both were stolen.

Repeatedly ran into a Hafrún it could not break, clicked for credits up to 44 credits, and on the final turn bounced off HQ three times instead of contesting the advancing Server 2 agenda that won the game.
Took heavy net damage from Urtica traps and a breakerless Karunā facecheck, but recovered with Shibboleth and Revolver and won through sustained R&D pressure.
R&D stayed behind one Tithe all game, and for the last seven turns the Corp clicked for credits up to 37 while discarding ice from a full hand, letting the Runner win off R&D.
Fast HQ pressure won in six turns; carried up to four tags against Weyland without clearing them, which was risky but went unpunished.
Built a strong remote but spent many turns clicking for credits and discarding from a full hand, then with no money lost a second Sericulture behind a single Diviner and Fujii from a one-ice HQ.
Ansel on R&D stalled the Runner and the Hagen remote scored out cleanly, but the Corp idled for several turns clicking for credits while holding 10-15 credits before starting to score.

Repeatedly ran into a known Vasilisa at zero credits and then spent turns paying off tags, did not pay 3 to get through Grubber while holding 26 credits, and clicked for credits while the Corp scored out of Server 2.
